label: About
description: The house, its story and the people who run it.

settings.text: A community house in a former bank, run by neighbours since 1984.

settings.body:
The house opened in 1984, when the bank on the corner of Larch Street closed and a group of neighbours asked the council for the keys. It has been open ever since: a hall, a small room, a kitchen and a back garden, kept going by a part-time coordinator, a committee and about sixty volunteers.

Nothing here needs a membership. Most groups are free, and the ones that charge keep it low so nobody is left out.

settings.heading: Run by its neighbours
settings.text: Every group started because someone asked. If there is something you would like to run, the room is probably free.

settings.heading: Lend a hand
settings.text: An hour a month or every week: there is always something.
